reset_human_to_tpose: reset a MuJoCo human model to a standing T-pose with zero velocity
reset_human_to_fall: reset a MuJoCo human model to a randomized falling state with random orientation and actions
reset_human_default_or_fall: reset a MuJoCo human model to either T-pose or a falling state based on a probability
convert_euler_to_quaternion: convert Euler angles to a quaternion using MuJoCo's mju_euler2Quat utility function
simulate_random_actions: simulate random control actions on a MuJoCo model for a specified number of integration steps
